subject: How to Integrate shiny with rApache?

messages.author: a085d632cefa4ed0
messages.subject: How to Integrate shiny with rApache?
parts:
Hi all,

Is there an easy way to integrate shiny with rApache ( http://rapache.net/ )?

I tried to launch shiny:::runApp in a R script which will be launched by apache as introduced in rApache, but it won't work.

The client will halt.



I guess that the output of shiny:::runApp should be redirect or do something to deliver to the client. But I don't know how to do that.

Thanks

Wush

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: How to Integrate shiny with rApache?
parts:
Unfortunately, no.

Shiny represents a new class of web applications that require very little HTTP and a lot of websockets. Whereas traditional web applications, including those hosted on rApache  and Rook, rely on the URL namespace for application logic, location of assets, etc... Shiny applications and those like them house their logic in javascript MVC patterns and communicate solely over websockets.

Shiny apps are hosted using the R websockets package which acts more like a tcp server than a web server, and that architecture just doesn't fit with rApache, or even apache for that matter.

Jeff
